details.question: How many days of annual leave do I get?
details.pipeline: You get 14 days of annual leave per year.
details.agent: You are entitled to 14 days of paid annual leave per year.

details.question: How many days in advance must I request leave?
details.pipeline: You must request leave at least 3 working days in advance.
details.agent: Leave must be requested at least **3 working days** in advance.

details.question: How many unused leave days can I carry over to next year?
details.pipeline: You can carry over up to 5 unused leave days to the next year.
details.agent: You can carry over up to 5 unused leave days to the next year.

details.question: How many days per week can I work remotely?
details.pipeline: You can work remotely up to 2 days per week.
details.agent: Employees may work remotely up to **2 days per week** with manager approval.

details.question: What are the core working hours?
details.pipeline: The core working hours are 10 AM to 4 PM.
details.agent: Core working hours are 10 AM to 4 PM.

details.question: How many days of paid sick leave do I get per year?
details.pipeline: You get 7 days of paid sick leave per year.
details.agent: Employees receive **7 days of paid sick leave per year**.

details.question: When do I need a medical certificate?
details.pipeline: A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 2 consecutive days.
details.agent: A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 2 consecutive days.

details.question: Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
details.pipeline: Within 30 days.
details.agent: Expense claims must be submitted within **30 days** of the expense.

details.question: Which expense claims need director approval?
details.pipeline: Expense claims exceeding 50,000 LKR require director approval.
details.agent: Expense claims exceeding 50,000 LKR require director approval.

details.question: What is the minimum password length?
details.pipeline: 12 characters.
details.agent: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long.

details.question: How often must I change my password?
details.pipeline: Every 90 days.
details.agent: Passwords must be changed every 90 days.

details.question: When must I connect to the VPN?
details.pipeline: You must connect to the VPN whenever you access internal systems from outside the office.

details.question: Within how long must a lost laptop be reported?

details.question: Who do I report a lost laptop to?
